entities.summary: Bruflat Church is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Etnedal Municipality in Innlandet county, Norway. It is located in the village of Bruflat. It is the church for the Bruflat parish which is part of the Valdres prosti (deanery) in the Diocese of Hamar. The brown, wooden church was built in a cruciform design in 1750 using plans drawn up by the architect Svend Tråseth. The church seats about 217 people.
